ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Extent of Child Nutrition Program Fraud
ideas.description: An in-depth investigation into the Feeding Our Future scheme and other potential cases of child nutrition program fraud
questions: How widespread is child nutrition program fraud?
What measures can be taken to prevent similar schemes in the future?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large-scale problem and spark meaningful reform. By following the money and investigating the financial transactions involved in these schemes, we can gain a better understanding of how they operate and how to prevent them.
